notes.title: Release date + new gameplay trailer revealed!
notes.notes:
[h3]Hey everyone, we’ve got some big news to share today as we finally reveal that [b]Tormented Souls 2 [/b]will launch on [b]23rd October 2025![/b][/h3][p][/p][p]To celebrate the rapidly-approaching release of our chilling throwback to classic survival horror, we’ve partnered with the [b]Future Games Show at Gamescom 2025[/b] to showcase a pulse-pounding [b]new gameplay trailer[/b], and reveal first details of the [b]monstrous bosses [/b]that Caroline will encounter while exploring the hellish[b] ‘Other side[/b]’ of Villa Hess.  [/p][p][/p][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44541046/8130011b6809b1f4e03959fedfd11c99c204c303.gif"][/img]
[/p][p]⚠️⚠️WARNING! Spoilers for Tormented Souls ahead! ⚠️⚠️[/p][h3]
[b]Check out the ‘A New Nightmare’ Gameplay Trailer as seen in the Future Games Show Gamescom Showcase![/b][/h3][p][/p][previewyoutube="2tW08Oy7QmY;full"][/previewyoutube][p]In the wake of her sister [b]Anna’s[/b] traumatic abduction at the hands of [b]Mother Lucia [/b]and her twisted cult, [b]Caroline Walker[/b] finds herself trapped deep within the walls of a maze-like convent. With the darkness closing in, Caroline is unexpectedly reacquainted with her old friend, the pneumatic nailer, and so begins a desperate struggle to escape the unholy place. But once free of the convent, the true horror of the secluded [b]Villa Hess[/b] reveals itself and Caroline must again [b]call upon her supernatural abilities[/b] to travel to the town’s mysterious [b]‘Other side’[/b] and face the formidable creatures that await within…[/p][p][/p][h3][b]Switching realities[/b][/h3][p][/p][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44541046/ce51573734c5757f933c3717242bf470475956ce.gif"][/img][/p][p]In the original [b]Tormented Souls[/b] it was Caroline’s latent supernatural powers that allowed her to[b] utilise mirrors and video tapes[/b] to traverse between [b]alternate realities[/b] and [b]timelines[/b] to ultimately save Anna from her cruel fate. [/p][p] In [b]Tormented Souls 2[/b], Caroline will continue to embrace these powers as she steps into Villa Hess’ mysterious ‘Other side’ and ‘replays’ memories stored on video tapes. Crucially Caroline’s actions in these locations will directly affect the current timeline in Villa Hess, while revealing more about the town’s dark history.[/p][p][/p][h3][b]The horrors of the ‘Other side’[/b][/h3][p][/p][p]Only the [b]foulest and most dangerous creatures[/b] reside within the ‘Other side’ and Caroline must be extra vigilant when exploring this twisted new reality. Deadliest of all are[b] beings of immense power[/b] that have gorged on the misery and corruption that envelops the region. [/p][p][/p][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44541046/2b84dd25ebd3bb1d8b6f349903891dfc5ee8c85d.jpg"][/img][/p][p]Wielding a huge crucifix and protected by a heavy plated mask, the [b]Iron Maiden[/b] is a hulking behemoth and cruel disciplinarian who administers punishment amongst the convent’s sisterhood.[/p][p][/p][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44541046/ebae69e4daf50e15406e4fdf7dcfa12b1d879c97.png"][/img][/p][p]Meanwhile, deep beneath the stinking halls of the [b]Wildberger & Hess Fish Processing Plant[/b] sleeps [b]The Harvester[/b], a terrifying fusion of twisted metal and scorched flesh. Armed with a lethal buzzsaw and gaping maw filled with razor sharp teeth, this subterranean horror seems impervious to all but the heaviest of weapons. [/p][p][/p][p]Until next time! [/p][p]Dual Effect & PQube[/p][p][/p]

notes.title: Demo update 1.0.2 is now live!
notes.notes:
[h3]Hi all![/h3][p][/p][p]We’re just checking in to give you a quick update on the Steam demo version of [b]Tormented Souls 2. [/b]Since launching a few weeks back over 27,000 players have now experienced this special demo edition, which is truly staggering! Naturally with so many of you playing, we’ve received A LOT of feedback which we have been reviewing and discussing as a team. [/p][p][/p][p]Today, we’re releasing the 1.0.2 patch for the demo which addresses several of the bigger pain points that the community has raised, please read on for a full list of what we have changed.[/p][p][/p][h3][u][b]Improvements[/b][/u][/h3][p][/p][list][*][p]Added Type C control scheme.[/p][/*][*][p]Improved Anna's character model. [/p][/*][*][p]Increased radius size of interaction points. [/p][/*][*][p]Improved the animation of the lighter being equipped when coming off a ladder. [/p][/*][*][p]Fixed issue with physics on the elevator.[/p][/*][*][p]Several fixes to facial animations. [/p][/*][*][p]Improved melee weapon system on breakable objects. [/p][/*][*][p]Removed collision from breakable objects.[/p][/*][*][p]Added breakables on staircase at Belltower to decrease backtracking. [/p][/*][*][p]Added a new hint for the Cryptex puzzle. [/p][/*][*][p]Updated cable colour for electrical panel in Prison[/p][/*][*][p]Redesigned puzzle for electrical panel.[/p][/*][*][p]Added the ability to pick up the electrical panel puzzle hint. [/p][/*][*][p]Added zoom in/out feature on Map for Controller [/p][/*][*][p]Improved performance throughout. [/p][p][/p][/*][/list][h3][b][u]Bug fixes[/u] [/b][/h3][p][/p][list][*][p]Fixed an issue where occasionally players would get into a softlock when dashing with Hammer and switching instantly to the Nailer. [/p][/*][*][p]Fixed an issue where the Cryptex puzzle where the mesh would separate from the puzzle. [/p][/*][*][p]Fixed an issue where players will be stuck in auto aiming when switching from the Lighter to the Nailer.[/p][/*][*][p]Fixed issue with corrupted map in Jailer room.[/p][/*][*][p]Fixed a bug where you could attack an enemy before the jump scare. [/p][/*][*][p]Fixed an issue where the shortcut menu will not work when coming off a ladder. [/p][/*][*][p]Fixed a crash when loading auto save in Basement and then entering South Corridor 1F[/p][/*][*][p]Fixed issue with FPS dropping when opening the Map.[/p][/*][/list][p][/p][p]Thanks for all the feedback and support, we’ll endeavour to address as much as possible before the final release this year, and we’ll be back with more updates over the coming months. [/p][p][/p][p]Dual Effect and PQube.[/p][p]
[/p]

notes.title: 🎉Demo OUT NOW! 🎉
notes.notes:
[h3]Nailer and lighter at the ready, the [b]Tormented Souls 2 [/b]demo is OUT NOW and available to play 🥳 PLUS we can now reveal our updated keyart featuring a completely [b]new look for Caroline[/b] that pays tribute to her iconic threads from the original game![/h3][p][/p][h3]🚨WARNING Tormented Souls spoilers ahead! 🚨 [/h3][p][/p][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44541046/56da4c8b603530ccfd77fd7d6c8c9427778a994e.jpg"][/img][/p][p][/p][h3][b]The story so far…[/b][/h3][p][/p][p]Following the harrowing events at Wildberger Hospital, Caroline Walker hopes for a normal life with her sister, Anna. Yet in the months that follow, Anna is haunted by visions of violence and death, compelling her to create disturbing drawings that rapidly manifest into horrifying reality.
[/p][p]Desperate to free her of this affliction, Caroline travels to the remote town of Villa Hess and a mysterious clinic nestled deep within the mountains of southern Chile. But behind the warm smiles of the facility’s serene staff lies a sickening truth, and the sisters soon find themselves at the center of an entirely new nightmare…
[/p][h3][b]So what’s included in the demo?[/b][/h3][p][/p][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44541046/1ee14a77e8f523ad20d9355600730348a6373056.jpg"][/img][/p][p]This first playable demo features roughly 60 minutes of gameplay, beginning with the sisters' long journey to Villa Hess and their arrival at the convent-turned-clinic as recommended by Caroline’s long-standing friend and psychiatrist, Isabella. Greeted by the cheerful Sister Angelica, a member of the convent’s secretive sisterhood, the pair seem initially at ease. But during the night Caroline wakes to find Anna missing and following the sounds of her screaming, rushes headfirst into the horrifying scene of her sister’s abduction. Trapped in a stranglehold, Caroline begins to lose consciousness as the sisterhood’s matriarch, Mother Lucia reveals her plan to capture the Wildberger twins and continue the unthinkable work of their grandfather, Noah… [/p][p][/p][p]Coming around in the convent’s infirmary, Caroline must now navigate the claustrophobic passageways of the convent in search of her missing sister. But as she ventures deeper into the shadowy facility, she soon discovers that she is not alone and that an ancient evil calls from below…  [/p][p][/p][h3][b]An insight into Caroline’s new look[/b][/h3][p][/p][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44541046/17b2e2754a91850ed7d7ad16c84591f686513cbf.jpg"][/img][/p][p]As many of our fans will know, Tormented Souls was initially conceived as a love letter to the iconic third-person survival horror titles of the 90s and early 00s. These games shared some fairly outlandish plots as well as memorable protagonists whose designs effortlessly combined B-movie horror aesthetics with the eye-catching fashion trends of the time. Looking back on Claire Redfield’s Queen-quoting biker jackets in [b]Resident Evil 2[/b] and [b]Code Veronica[/b] and Aya Brea’s none-more-nineties denim in [b]Parasite Eve II[/b] got us thinking about our design for Caroline Walker in [b]Tormented Souls 2[/b]. Had we moved too far away from our influences? Would Caroline’s silhouette still be recognizable? What would Caroline think about her militaristic, combat-ready new look?[/p][p][/p][p]These questions led us to revisit her design once more, going over and picking out all the key details of her outfit from the original game, and seeking to ‘evolve’ her look for the sequel. The most important point was that following the events of the first game, Caroline has grown up. She’s very much in BIG SISTER mode now, and so needs to look suitably mature. This is reflected in her color palette, with the blood red of her dress contrasting dramatically with the scuffed leather of her jacket, which conveniently helps to pick her out of the multitude of dark environments that she’ll be exploring throughout the game.[/p][p][/p][p]We also wanted to retain elements of her design so as to keep her silhouette relatively consistent between games. This meant bringing back the dress and jacket combo, as well as Caroline’s taste for floral patterns, bows, and leather. Some of you might remember the evolution of The Prince’s design from [b]Prince of Persia: The Sands of Time[/b] to [b]Warrior Within[/b]. Across games, he retained his flowing sash, chunky arm bracers, and loose-fitting trousers, but undeniably looks more bad-ass in the sequel. This is very much the approach we took with Caroline’s new look, and we hope our players will enjoy the familiarity it now brings! Also bonus points for anyone who noticed the Alice Abernathy reference 😉[/p][p][/p][p]We hope you’ll enjoy stepping back into the world of [b]Tormented Souls [/b]once more. If you do have any feedback about the demo or encounter any bugs please do add your comments to [url="https://steamcommunity.com/app/2464280/discussions/0/603032266031011013/"]this thread.[/url] [/p][p][/p][p]Tomorrow, June 7th we’ll also be featuring in the [b]Latin American Games Showcase [/b]with a new story teaser trailer. You can watch live from 11am PT / 7pm BST via [url="https://www.twitch.tv/lagshowcase"]Twitch[/url] and [url="https://www.youtube.com/@LAGShowcase"]YouTube. [/url][/p][p][/p][p]Enjoy![/p][p]Dual Effect & PQube[/p][p]
[/p]

notes.title: 🚨Tormented Souls 2 demo & new look for Caroline incoming!🚨
notes.notes:
Hey everyone! 

It’s been quite some time since our last post but today we’re finally ready to share some big news! [b]Tormented Souls 2[/b] has been selected to feature in the [b]Latin American Games Showcase[/b] during [b]Summer Game Fest[/b] which will take place on [b]7th June @ 11am PT / 7pm BST[/b] via [url=https://www.twitch.tv/lagshowcase]Twitch[/url] and [url=https://www.youtube.com/@LAGShowcase]YouTube.[/url]

To celebrate we’ll be releasing a [b]brand new story teaser trailer[/b] during the event which introduces several major characters, and shines the spotlight on the [b]mysterious town[/b] that Caroline will be exploring over the course of the game. Keep an eye out for several never before seen locations 👀 

On top of this we’ll also be revealing an entirely [b]redesigned look for Caroline[/b] which not only reflects feedback we have received since announcement, but also pays tribute to her iconic style from the original [b]Tormented Souls[/b]! We can’t wait to share this with you but for now here’s a sneak peak of our [b]brand-new keyart[/b] (hot of the press!) featuring a [b]familiar looking silhouette[/b]😉 

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44541046/f99bd6f63e96d2530d9b4341efd2914ea4118751.jpg[/img]

But that’s not all! We’re proud to announce that our [b]first playable Steam demo[/b] will be available to play the day before the showcase [b]on June 6th at approximately 8am PT / 4pm BST[/b] 🥳This demo will feature the [b]first 60 minutes of gameplay[/b] and will have you navigating the claustrophobic passageways of a sinister convent in search of a gruesome ancient tome…

Lastly, we just wanted to say thank you for your patience and support over the last year. It's been a long road getting to this point, but we’re finally on the home stretch and can’t wait to share more news and information over the coming months as we head towards launch in late 2025 😀

Until next time!

Dual Effect & PQube

notes.title: 🕯️ Tormented Souls 2 is Announced! The Survival Horror Classic Is Back! 🕯️
notes.notes:
Hello survival horror fans…

We are extremely excited to announce that Tormented Souls 2 is coming soon to Steam!

Caroline Walker returns in the highly anticipated sequel to the award-winning classic survival horror! Stalk the shadow-drenched halls of haunting monasteries and other nightmarish locations, and brace yourself to confront terrifying creatures armed only with makeshift weapons as you desperately try to rescue your cursed sister.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44541046/dee23828ba5bc12c19e4a53358ec8eed851147ae.png[/img]
[previewyoutube=sdukBQuWCcE;full][/previewyoutube]


[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44541046/ce9dc316849677a1734c682d20635699b4abe482.png[/img]
After the events at Wildberger Hospital, Caroline yearns for a normal life with her younger sister, Anna. However, fate has other plans. Conventional remedies prove futile as Anna falls victim to a mysterious affliction, coughing blood and experiencing blackened eyes and moments of unconsciousness. In a desperate bid to save her sister, Caroline must turn to the supernatural..,

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44541046/d615541768b39d63670daa1401c59b4baaec36fb.png[/img]
Step into the nightmare that is Puerto Miller, a remote Southern American town with a chilling past. Founded by the antient, reclusive Ismuit tribe, the town conceals unspeakable horrors beneath its ancient exterior. Explore its dark secrets if you dare...

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44541046/60c0df89212659ffde04ad22f384d2568088d429.png[/img]
Face pulse-pounding combat as you confront monstrous creatures using a range of ingenious makeshift weapons. Every corner may hide an enemy, so resource management is key to survival.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44541046/3f8239c7a7b7d213e6cba9938880be9773a12de5.png[/img]
Utilise logic and reasoning to forge connections between items found in the environment and intricately designed puzzles. Creatively combine resources to unlock twisted enigmas and delve deeper into the dark mysteries that shroud your path. 🧠🔐

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44541046/d23dda85b3555d99df908f79a77cf0aadaf6b608.png[/img]
https://store.steampowered.com/app/2464280/Tormented_Souls_2/
